title: John 6:37-40
subtitle: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed (All Souls) · Wis 3:1-9; Rom 5:5-11 or Rom 6:3-9; Jn 6:37-40
text: Today the Church prays for all who have died, especially those still being made ready to see God. Jesus promised, "I will not reject anyone who comes to me," and "I shall raise him on the last day." Visit a grave, have a Mass offered, and say their names.
imageAlt: Two women in black mourning dress kneel and embrace at a stone cross in an autumn cemetery; one hangs a wreath of pale flowers on the cross while the other holds a second wreath.
credit: William-Adolphe Bouguereau, The Day of the Dead (Le Jour des morts), 1859, Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
